items.title_en: ‘Anything but ban paan masala’: Mumbai Metro’s ‘spit bin’ makes some queasy
items.title_zh: “除了ban paan masala什么都行”：孟买地铁的“吐痰箱”让人感到恶心
items.summary_en: The unusual facility was highlighted by X user Zoru Bhathena, who posted a photograph of the bin with the caption 'My Mumbai Metro, Now with dedicated Spitting Zones'.
items.summary_zh: X 用户 Zoru Bhathena 强调了这个不寻常的设施，他发布了一张垃圾箱的照片，并配上标题“我的孟买地铁，现在有专门的随地吐痰区”。

items.title_en: Why a Chinese doctor with a PhD quit her job to become a delivery rider
items.title_zh: 为什么一位拥有博士学位的中国医生辞去工作成为一名送货骑手
items.summary_en: After quitting the hospital, Liu Zihan travelled before taking unconventional jobs, selling breakfast, working as a delivery rider and singing at a pub.
items.summary_zh: 出院后，刘紫函开始外出旅游，从事过卖早餐、当送货员、在酒吧唱歌等非传统工作。

items.title_en: From Dante’s Inferno to desert dunes: The 7 most beautiful train stations in the world
items.title_zh: 从但丁的地狱到沙漠沙丘：世界上 7 个最美丽的火车站
items.summary_en: Anish Kapoor's Monte Sant'Angelo Station located in Naples was one of the seven finalists announced by Prix Versailles in the World's most beautiful train stations.
items.summary_zh: 安尼什·卡普尔 (Anish Kapoor) 设计的位于那不勒斯的圣天使山车站是凡尔赛奖公布的世界最美火车站七家决赛入围者之一。

items.title_en: What’s ‘automatic’ about Gurugram’s new garbage cleaning machine? Internet isn’t convinced
items.title_zh: 古尔冈的新型垃圾清洁机有什么“自动”功能？互联网不相信
items.summary_en: The white, scooter-like machine, which carries the Municipal Corporation of Gurugram logo, is being used to collect litter from roadsides.
items.summary_zh: 这台白色的、类似摩托车的机器带有古尔冈市政公司的标志，用于收集路边的垃圾。

items.title_en: Why an Indian man felt ‘embarrassed’ after meeting a Swiss retiree in Vietnam
items.title_zh: 为什么印度男子在越南见到瑞士退休人员后感到“尴尬”
items.summary_en: A chance meeting with a retired Swiss corporate lawyer in Hanoi left investment professional Manuraaj Garg reflecting on India’s work culture, short holidays, and the value of free time.
items.summary_zh: 投资专业人士 Manuraaj Garg 在河内与一位退休的瑞士企业律师的一次偶然会面，让他反思了印度的工作文化、短暂的假期和空闲时间的价值。

items.title_en: ‘UN in Reality’: Iran mocks world body with ‘Sholay’ Thakur meme
items.title_zh: “现实中的联合国”：伊朗用“Sholay”塔库尔表情包嘲笑世界机构
items.summary_en: Iran’s Embassy in India used Doctor Strange and Sholay’s Thakur in a meme mocking the UN’s perceived limits in responding to global conflicts.
items.summary_zh: 伊朗驻印度大使馆在一条表情包中使用了奇异博士和绍莱的塔库尔来嘲笑联合国在应对全球冲突方面的局限性。

items.title_en: As Trump calls Sundar Pichai a ‘monster’, Google CEO responds
items.title_zh: 特朗普称桑达尔·皮查伊为“怪物”，谷歌首席执行官回应
items.summary_en: The remark came as Trump spoke to reporters outside the White House following a meeting with several prominent technology executives.
items.summary_zh: 特朗普在与几位著名科技高管会面后在白宫外对记者发表了上述言论。

items.title_en: The Eerie Story Of The Porsche 550 Spyder That James Dean Was Driving When He Died In A Tragic Crash In 1955
items.title_zh: 1955 年詹姆斯·迪恩 (James Dean) 驾驶的保时捷 550 Spyder 在一场悲惨车祸中丧生时的怪诞故事
items.summary_en: Bettman/Getty Images James Dean in his 1955 Porsche 550 Spyder shortly before his death in September 1955. On Sept. 30, 1955, 24-year-old James Dean died in a violent car crash while traveling to Salinas, California. In the aftermath of the tragedy, rumors began to spread that James Dean’s Porsche 550 Spyder was cursed.
items.summary_zh: Bettman/Getty Images 詹姆斯·迪恩 (James Dean) 驾驶着他的 1955 年款保时捷 550 Spyder，在 1955 年 9 月去世前不久。1955 年 9 月 30 日，24 岁的詹姆斯·迪恩 (James Dean) 在前往加利福尼亚州萨利纳斯的途中遭遇严重车祸身亡。悲剧发生后，关于詹姆斯·迪恩的保时捷 550 Spyder 被诅咒的谣言开始流传。

items.title_en: How Dorothea Lange Revealed The True Horrors Of The Great Depression Through Her Photography
items.title_zh: 多萝西娅·兰格如何通过她的摄影揭示大萧条的真正恐怖
items.summary_en: In the 1930s, Dorothea Lange photos circulated in newspapers and publications throughout the United States, putting faces to the horror stories of the Great Depression. Lange began her career taking portraits in a studio, but in the mid-1930s, she became a photographer with the Resettlement Administration (later known as the Farm Security Administration). Click here to view slideshow One of her most famous images is Migrant Mother, which became a symbol of the hardships of the era. It shows a woman, her face lined…
items.summary_zh: 20 世纪 30 年代，多萝西娅·兰格的照片在美国各地的报纸和出版物上流传，展现了大萧条时期的恐怖故事。兰格的职业生涯始于在工作室拍摄肖像，但在 20 世纪 30 年代中期，她成为移民管理局（后来称为农场安全管理局）的一名摄影师。点击此处查看幻灯片 她最著名的照片之一是“移民母亲”，它成为了艰难困苦的象征。

items.title_en: Archaeologists In Turkey Just Found A 2,100-Year-Old Shipwreck Filled With Luxury Tableware Once Highly Prized In Ancient Rome
items.title_zh: 土耳其考古学家刚刚发现了一艘有 2100 年历史的沉船，里面装满了古罗马曾经备受珍视的豪华餐具
items.summary_en: Turkish Ministry of Culture and Tourism Thankfully for researchers, these pieces were preserved in shockingly good condition, as they’d been carefully packed into wooden crates and separated with layers of clay for protection. Archaeologists excavating a shipwreck off the Mediterranean coast of Turkey found thousands of pieces of tableware that the vessel had been carrying — ceramic plates, bowls, and serving dishes — when it sank some 2,100 years ago. Researchers believe the cargo originated from the region…
items.summary_zh: 土耳其文化和旅游部 值得庆幸的是，研究人员发现，这些作品的保存状况出奇的好，因为它们被小心地装入木箱中，并用粘土层隔开进行保护。考古学家在土耳其地中海沿岸挖掘一艘沉船，发现了大约 2100 年前沉船时所携带的数千件餐具，包括陶瓷盘子、碗和餐具。研究人员认为
